newsitem.title: GERMANY: Deutsche-Horlick in talks with legal staff member.
newsitem.headline: Deutsche-Horlick in talks with legal staff member.

text.p: Nicola Horlick, former head of British pension fund business at MGAM, was speaking to a senior member of staff in Deutsche Bank's legal department, a spokesman for the bank said on Friday.
"I don't know what is being discussed, but now that she has come here we must listen to her to find out what she wants," a Deutsche Bank spokesman told Reuters.

Horlick was suspended earlier from Deutsche Morgan Grenfell Asset Management this week pending the outcome of an investigation into what DMG described as "a potential breach of her contract" and Horlick resigned on Thursday.
